quests.title: The Clock at Kirrawee
quests.blurb: The clock on this platform has been four minutes fast since I got here and every relief who comes through wants to fix it. Do not fix it. Go and find out who set it, before they retire.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Gymea, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Villawood
quests.blurb: There is a dog that meets the 5:40 at Villawood every weekday and has done for months, and nobody gets off for it. I have decided this is not going to be a sad story. Find out whose it is.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Clyde
quests.blurb: I run a small book on things that are not races and someone is beating it. Not by much and not by luck. Ride the run they ride, watch what they watch, and tell me what they know that I do not.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$31 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Kingswood
quests.blurb: The last one through Kingswood carries four people and one of them is always asleep. Ride it to Penrith, photograph what the platform looks like with nobody on it, and come back and tell me it is still there.

steps.label: ride the late one to Penrith
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Mulgrave Tap-Off
quests.blurb: Somebody taps on at Mulgrave every morning and never taps off. Same card. I want you to ride the run they ride and find where a person can get off this network without a gate seeing them.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph the gap before somebody welds it

quests.title: The St James Order
quests.blurb: I do two hundred coffees between six and nine and I know every one of them by the walk. One of my regulars stopped coming. Take a coffee to where they work and find out whether they are dead or just went to the other place.

steps.label: order one at the St James kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $49 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Marion
quests.blurb: The board at Marion says four minutes. It has said four minutes for as long as anyone can remember and it is a lie about a third of the time. Stand there. Time it. Bring me numbers instead of feelings.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Chinatown
quests.blurb: Everything anyone has ever left on a train ends up in a room, and the room is full. Most of it nobody wants. One of them somebody wants very badly and has not come to ask. Find out why.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$45 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Padstow
quests.blurb: There is a sign and the sign is not enforced by anybody, which makes it the only law in this city that runs on shame. Somebody has stopped feeling it. Ride the Padstow run and deal with it.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Bondi Junction Shortcut
quests.blurb: Every courier in this city has a route that is not on any map and mine goes through Bondi Junction. They have started locking one end of it. Go and find out whether it is locked forever or just locked today.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs me
$44, which is what the long way costs me a week
